question: What formal condition constrains the admissible continuation term in D(RT_n | continuation) so the recursive engine remains inside the lawful distinction domain?

disposition.summary: A continuation term C is supported as admissible when it is a typed distinction-domain member with nonzero distinction, declared admissibility context, PRIN_003-compatible coupling to RT_n, distinguishable typed residue, and preservation of distinction, admissibility, residue closure, and non-collapse.

formal_scaffold.candidate_condition: ContAdm(C; RT_n, x) := Type(C)=distinction_domain and E(C)!=0 and AdmCtx(C)!=empty and Coupl_003(RT_n,C,x) and ResidueDistinct(RT_n,C) and NonCollapse(RT_n,C)
formal_scaffold.continuation_rule: D(RT_n | C) -> RT_{n+1} only if ContAdm(C; RT_n, x)
premises: C is a typed member of the distinction domain.
C carries an explicit admissibility context.
C couples to RT_n through a declared PRIN_003 family relation.
C carries typed residue distinguishable from the residue of RT_n.
The coupled continuation preserves distinction, admissibility, residue closure, and non-collapse.
Zero-residue participation, if present, satisfies GOV-RT-ZERO-RECOUPLING-001.
formal_scaffold.exclusion_rule: Candidates that are untyped, null, residue-erasing, PRIN_003-incompatible, or collapse distinction are inadmissible continuations.

failure_conditions: The continuation term has zero or non-realizable distinction under the declared context.
No PRIN_003-compatible coupling to RT_n is declared.
Typed residue is erased, aliased, or overlaps in a way that collapses traceability.
The coupled continuation collapses distinction, admissibility, or residue closure.
The condition is used to bypass local well-formedness, typed residue, or trace-admissibility checks.

remaining_work: Convert the campaign-supported condition into a formal proof artifact if theorem promotion is requested.
Run independent rigor endorsement before raising the induction ceiling.
Check compatibility with OQ_RTM_001 trace inheritance and OQ_RTM_003 base-case trace.
Audit recursive-engine uses for attempts to bypass typed continuation checks.

does_not_prove: Universal recursive soundness outside declared continuation controls.
Physical recurrence, conservation, or ontological permanence.
That every syntactic continuation term is admissible.
